name: georgia-income-tax
description: Personal income tax in the country of Georgia (Sakartvelo, GE, currency GEL; not the US state) for tax year 2026 under the Tax Code of Georgia. Covers residence (183 days in any 12 months), the flat 20% rate, the 5% rates for residential rent and for gains on a flat, house or car, the holding-period exemptions, the exemption for foreign-source income of residents, micro business status (0%, GEL 30,000, no staff) and small business status (1%, then 3% from the month gross income passes GEL 500,000, or GEL 700,000 for wine and agro tourism), final withholding on dividends and interest (5%), royalties, the annual return due before 1 April, the monthly small business return, current tax payments, fines and 0.05% a day penalty interest. Trigger on: Georgia income tax, 20% flat tax Georgia, small business status 1%, micro business Georgia, individual entrepreneur Georgia, rs.ge declaration.
